-# the main GPT text split patterns, see
+def _split_special(text, special):
+    # same as re.split("(" + "|".join(map(re.escape, special)) + ")", text):
+    # the leftmost occurrence of any token wins, ties go to the earlier token
+    # in alternation (dict) order; matching resumes after the match
+    keys = list(special)
+    if "" in special:
+        pattern = "(" + "|".join(re.escape(k) for k in keys) + ")"
+        return re.split(pattern, text)
+    find = text.find
+    nxt = [find(k) for k in keys]
+    out = []
+    pos = 0
+    while True:
+        best = -1
+        bi = 0
+        for i, j in enumerate(nxt):
+            if j >= 0 and (best < 0 or j < best):
+                best = j
+                bi = i
+        if best < 0:
+            break
+        k = keys[bi]
+        out.append(text[pos:best])
+        out.append(k)
+        pos = best + len(k)
+        for i, j in enumerate(nxt):
+            if 0 <= j < pos:
+                nxt[i] = find(keys[i], pos)
+    out.append(text[pos:])
+    return out
+
